title: Bored Aiko - Resources pack
description: ’Inside the system - Bored Aiko‘ accompanying resource pack
body:
Bored Aiko - Resources pack

[中文]:

本材质包为数据包“Bored Aiko”的专用材质包，安装该材质包时需同时安装“[內部系统](https://modrinth.com/mod/inside-the-system)”模组最新Demo版与[数据包](https://modrinth.com/datapack/itsba)

[English]:

This resource pack is a dedicated pack for the data pack 'Bored Aiko'. When installing this resource pack, you also need to install the latest Demo version of the '[Inside the System](https://modrinth.com/mod/inside-the-system)' mod along with the [data pack](https://modrinth.com/datapack/itsba).
